name: Mock Layer 3 Switch Driver
notes: Hardware-free L3 switch driver for integration tests. Acknowledges route operations (configure_route, remove_route, including interface routes with next_hop None) deterministically and supports failure injection via HERD_mock_fail_actions / HERD_mock_raise_actions / HERD_mock_sleep_ms field_data. Not for production use. Declares supports_vrf (ADR 0014 addendum X-G, issue #755): configure_route and remove_route accept a virtual_router keyword and record it in the transcript so integration tests can assert it reached the driver.
